subject.title: `before_agent_run` receives no input provenance; several producers never stamp it — internal wakes look like user input at the gate

question: Which run producers may authoritatively assign each `InputProvenance.kind`, and should `before_agent_run` initially expose the complete provenance object or only its host-authored kind?
rationale: Plugins may use this value to permit or block model execution, so an incorrect or user-influenceable classification would create a security and compatibility contract rather than a local typing change.

options.title: Approve authoritative optional provenance
options.body: Define per-producer authority and expose normalized `inputProvenance?: InputProvenance`, preserving `undefined` for genuinely unknown origins.

options.title: Expose kind only initially
options.body: Expose only the host-authored three-way kind while deferring optional source metadata until its trust and compatibility contracts are settled.

options.title: Keep the gate content-only
options.body: Decline origin-based gating and explicitly document that `before_agent_run` does not provide an authoritative trigger identity.

recommendation.title: Approve authoritative optional provenance
recommendation.body: Define per-producer authority and expose normalized `inputProvenance?: InputProvenance`, preserving `undefined` for genuinely unknown origins.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the cron, subagent, and compaction producer boundaries assigned to this ownership area, with plugin-hook contributors available for the API follow-through.
